intro.text: A shimmering gate rises from the Evermore marsh. [image1.png] Do you step through?

crossing.text: You cross into Evermore. The air smells of rain and old magic. A cloaked guide beckons you forward.

observe.text: You study the runes and notice a hidden crest of DragonZMind etched into the stone.

guide.text: The guide offers you a choice of path: the Ember Road or the Silver River.

forest.text: Whispers in the trees warn of unseen watchers. You prepare your gear and press on.

ember.text: Heat waves rise from the Ember Road. In the distance, a fortress glows with molten light.

river.text: The Silver River hums with enchantment. Your journey continues along its radiant banks.
